page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Two notes in the left margin: "GRONINGA." beside the line "GRO-NINGA", and "Aggeres fluitibus opposita." beside the start of the second paragraph. Page number and running head at the top, centred over the text. No catchword.
page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.l: Frisiam jure, quibus se debere hinc atque
legibus, institutis per multa nunc sæcula
ad Selverdios, à Selverdiis viciffim ad
nuto veteri vicanorum jure ac libertate,
attribuerunt. Atque hujus in solo, ubi
in dorso inter camporum humilia lingua
instar se porrigente, sedem habet G R o-
N I N G A nostra, de quà nunc scribimus
Regio universa ab exitu Lavicæ per
ambages varias, quà æstuarium se curvat,
quà Hunesus egreditur, quà vadum à

page.notes: The first word of the page is a fragment, "vi," (Roman numeral VI, shown as a small-letter form in print). The left-margin notes are the two lines printed in small type beside the text. The printed hyphen in "G R o-" and "N I N G A" is kept as printed. The final word "septen-" runs over to the next page and is left as a fragment. Running head and page number are printed at the top.
